Select distinct compound ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the human CB1 receptor (CHEMBL218). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays filtered by assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens', then to target_dictionary filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL218'. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier.
